extracted.name: Easy German Chocolate Cake Icing
extracted.description: Whip up a batch of this quick and easy icing for German chocolate cake made with coconut and pecans.
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir brown sugar, coconut, pecans, and milk into hot butter; bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring constantly, until thick and bubbling, about 3 minutes.
